description: One confirmed funding event: what Rest has been told has been paid for. The app's credit ledger imports from these records, so a row here is the authority for units the app will let a church spend.

fields.description: The idempotency key Rest supplies. UNIQUE, and that is the whole reason a redelivered confirmation is safe: the app retries when a response is lost, and a second request under the same key must return this record rather than create another.
fields.label: Event ID

fields.description: The Rest deployment that confirmed this funding. A Link, not free text: the row is created automatically on first contact, so this resolves to a record carrying the deployment's display name, its activity and an operator's active/inactive decision.
fields.label: Instance ID

fields.description: The payer's invoice or receipt number, as recorded in Rest.
fields.label: Purchase Reference

fields.description: Rest organization id. A plain string, deliberately: the app's organization model is its own, and mirroring it as a Customer or a custom DocType is a decision the customers-and-pricing workstream has not taken.
fields.label: Organization ID

fields.description: The organization's name as the Rest app knows it. Denormalised on purpose: this record is what an operator scans, and joining elsewhere to find out who paid defeats the point. The id above remains authoritative.
fields.label: Organization

fields.description: Rest funding-group id: the group that paid and whose balance the units land in.
fields.label: Funding Group ID

fields.description: The funding group that paid, by name. Same reasoning as the organization name: readable here, keyed on the id.
fields.label: Funding Group

fields.description: SMS and email credit are separate balances and are never interchangeable.
fields.label: Channel

fields.description: Service units granted: SMS segments or email messages. An integer, never a float — the app's ledger is exact and a fractional unit has no meaning.
fields.label: Units

fields.description: Money paid, in the currency's MINOR units (cents, pesewas). Integer only: 11250 means 112.50. A float here would round somebody's payment.
fields.label: Amount (minor units)

fields.description: Price per unit in MILLIONTHS of a major unit, so 0.045 is 45000 exactly. The app's rate card uses the same scale.
fields.label: Unit Price (micros)

fields.description: Optional. When the funding corresponds to a real ERPNext payment, link it here: it makes the funding record auditable against the books instead of a standalone claim.
fields.label: ERPNext Payment Document
Payment Document Type
fields.description: Pick the doctype first (Payment Entry, Sales Invoice, Journal Entry ...), then choose the document. A Dynamic Link needs both halves, which is why this is visible.
A clickable link to the payment above, once both halves are set.
fields.label: Payment Link

fields.description: When the authority recorded this confirmation. Set by the API on insert and never edited afterwards.
fields.label: Confirmed At

name: Rest Communication Credit Funding
